title: Legislative districts of Tarlac
wikitext:
{{Short description|Legislative district of the Philippines}} {{Politics of the Philippines}} The '''legislative districts of Tarlac''' are the representations of the [[Provinces of the Philippines|province]] of [[Tarlac]] in the [[List of legislatures of the Philippines|various national legislatures]] of the [[Philippines]]. The province is currently represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|lower house]] of the [[Congress of the Philippines]] through its [[#1st District|first]], [[#2nd District|second]], and [[#3rd District|third]] congressional districts. == History == The province was divided into two [[House of Representatives of the Philippines#District representation|legislative districts]] until 1972. It was part of the representation of [[Interim Batasang Pambansa|Region III]] from 1978 to 1984, and from 1984 to 1986 it elected two assemblymen at-large.
